### gemini-code-assist[bot] · 2026-09-10 · COMMENTED

## Code Review

This pull request introduces mixed-precision quantization scripts for GLM-5.3-Flash and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, along with a decompression script for GLM-5.3-Flash. It also adds support for the `glm5_next` model architecture by updating MoE conversion mappings, adding `swiglu_limit` handling in `LinearExperts2D`, and adding corresponding tests. Feedback on the changes highlights several issues: hardcoded user directories in file paths across the new scripts, a commented-out distributed initialization call (`init_dist()`) in the Qwen script, redundant manual re-attachment of `swiglu_limit` in the GLM script, and incorrect references to DeepSeek-V3.2 in the decompression script's comments.
